description: The rules of formalised law put into words: exactly how a predicate is derived (premises, source articles). Call this BEFORE supplying facts to law_ask — the rules say which facts are needed instead of leaving them to be guessed. For large instruments package=… returns a table of contents; the full text comes from predicate=…. The listing by package is paged: limit (20 by default, 500 at most) and offset; the remainder is named in the text (`showing a–b of N; k more`) and in structuredContent (total, truncated, next — a ready-made continuation call).

lang.description: the language the rules are put into (DECISION-0032; the language of the profile by default; the rest are draft packs, with §218 label overlays)

limit.description: package: how many rules per page (20; the budget may lower it)

predicate.description: the rules that derive this predicate

name: law_rules
